reading_issues: Measured at pixel level on the native chart image extracted from the PDF (0 cm at y=1424, HS 130 at y=87; K/P/1f/4f/F ticks evenly spaced; all layer boundaries land on whole cm). Elevation, aspect, air temperature, sky, wind and blowing snow are blank ('--') in the header (null). No grain-form table (Name column only), so every layer's grain is null; named crusts are K-hardness but their crust type (MFcr vs other) is not stated. Surface grain 'Rime 2.0-3.0mm' stored as PP (PPrm) per convention. The Dec 15 Cr bar is partly hidden behind the CT25 label; its left edge was traced through the semi-transparent label and ends on the K tick. CT25 line is drawn at the crust top (84 cm) but notes say 'Underneath cr', so the true failure plane may be the crust base (83 cm). '* 2' after the CT25 note read as a x2 repeat (count 2). Notes text 'CTM 17 RP' / 'CTH 25 SC' kept as raw. No temperature profile on the chart. Spelling 'Vermillion' follows the chart title and filename.
